title: Concept: Composer accepts unstable packages globally
description: composer.json declares a `minimum-stability` below stable, which leaves a dependency the reviewer cannot reason about: Every constraint in the project can resolve to a prerelease or a development build, which sits outside most advisory ranges.
applicability: Projects that resolve dependencies through composer.json (composer).
risk: Every constraint in the project can resolve to a prerelease or a development build, which sits outside most advisory ranges.
